curated-boska-gf-red-hat-text: Carved stone meets technical pen. Boska's sharp swings between heavy and hairline strokes take the stage, while Red Hat Text keeps one smooth, curvy outline you could trace with a finger.
curated-dafont-pixel-operator-work-sans: Retro terminal energy, softened. Pixel Operator sets rigid, code-style blocks against the full-shouldered curves of Work Sans, a mix that would look right at home on, say, settings toggles.
curated-gf-allura-gf-della-respira: Della Respira brings tall capitals and real editorial weight. Allura's smooth, huddled pen script supplies the sweetness, a loose fit for a cute bakery and a couple of lines.
curated-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-hand-pre-gf-tsu: Casual crayon on rough paper. Edu VIC WA NT Hand Pre earns its keep big and brief, while Tsukimi Rounded keeps its round, parallel-edged curves quietly in the background.
curated-gf-jersey-10-charted-gf-noto-nas: Jersey 10 Charted comes in tight and bold. Noto Nastaliq Urdu reads with a dignified, editorial hush, its vertical rhythm tight and its ascenders low, so brevity treats it best.
curated-gf-kapakana-gf-spectral-sc: Loose, nearly merging pen letters. Kapakana does its best work in a few lines of casual, closed-up script, while Spectral SC offers wide-mouthed, sturdy-hairlined forms that hold up to careful reading.
